svg.title: What I've built
svg.desc: Four projects. Restaurant: a Telegram bot turns staff photos and a voice note into reels for Facebook, Instagram and TikTok and updates prices on the website and Glovo. Cleaning company: a crew app with QR sign-in, rota, check-ins and monthly hours reports. Online trading: a bot that posts one forwarded listing to five platforms. Definium: lead developer of a compliance platform for NIS2, DORA and GDPR with six modules and a public demo.
